## Assign nearest numbers from list

```{r}

numberSnap <- function(numbersIn, numberList, rangeVal){
  
  numberList<-sort(numberList)          # need them sorted
  rangeVal <- rangeVal*1.000001                             # avoid rounding issues
  nearest <- findInterval(numbersIn, numberList - rangeVal) # index of nearest
  nearest <- c(-Inf, numberList)[nearest + 1]  # value of nearest
  diff <- numbersIn - nearest                           # compute errors
  snap <- diff <= rangeVal                               # only snap near numbers
  
  numbersOut <- numbersIn
  numbersOut[snap] <- nearest[snap]                      # snap values to nearest
  
  return(numbersOut)
  
}


```

## Rescale ggplot tick marks for variables

```{r}

rescaleTicks <- function(dataVar, dataVarScl, sep=3, ax='x'){
  
  if (ax == 'x'){
    outAx <- scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(floor(min(dataVar)),
                                           ceiling(max(dataVar)),
                                           by=sep) -
                                  (max(dataVar) - max(dataVarScl)),
                                labels=seq(floor(min(dataVar)),
                                           ceiling(max(dataVar)),
                                           by=sep))

  } else if (ax == 'y'){
    outAx <- scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(floor(min(dataVar)),
                                           ceiling(max(dataVar)),
                                           by=sep) -
                                  (max(dataVar) - max(dataVarScl)),
                                labels=seq(floor(min(dataVar)),
                                           ceiling(max(dataVar)),
                                           by=sep))
  } else {
    stop("Invalid axis argument")
  }
 
  return(outAx) 
}


```

## Beta distribution transform from arbitrary scale to (0, 1) or back again

```{r}

betaTransform <- function(x, scaleMin, scaleMax,
                          direction=c('forward', 'reverse')[1],
                          squeeze=c('none', 'basic', 'smithson')[1],
                          basic_val=1e-6){
  "Squeeze algorithm is from:
  Smithson, M & Verkuilen, J, 2006. A better lemon squeezer? Maximum-likelihood
  regression with beta-distributed dependent variables. Psychological Methods,
  11(1), 54-71."
  
  if (direction == 'forward') {
    # transform from original scale to (0,1)
    x_scale <- (x - scaleMin) / (scaleMax - scaleMin)
    
    if (squeeze == 'smithson') {
      
      N = length(x_scale)
      x_out <- (x_scale*(N - 1) + 0.5) / N
      
    } else if (squeeze == 'basic') {
      
      x_out <- x_scale*(1 - 2*basic_val) + basic_val
      
    } else {
      
      x_out <- x_scale
      
    }

  } else if (direction == 'reverse') {
    # transform from (0, 1) back to original scale
    x_scale <- x * (scaleMax - scaleMin) + scaleMin
    
    if (squeeze == 'smithson') {
      
      N = length(x_scale)
      x_out <- (x_scale*N - 0.5)/(N - 1)
      
    } else if (squeeze == 'basic') {
      
      x_out <- (x_scale - basic_val)/(1 - 2*basic_val)
      
    } else {
      
      x_out <- x_scale
      
    }

  } else {
    
    stop("Invalid direction argument: must be 'forward' or 'reverse'")
    
  }
  
  return(x_out)
  
}


```

## Scaling multiple dataframes

```{r}

#' Standardise selected columns across a list of data frames
#'
#' Applies \code{datawizard::standardise()} to user-specified columns in each
#' data frame of a list, adding the result as new columns with "Scl"
#' appended to the original column name. Standardisation can be switched on
#' or off per variable via the \code{scale} argument.
#'
#' @param df_list A list of data frames.
#' @param vars    Character vector of column names to (optionally) standardise.
#' @param scale   Controls which variables get full standardisation vs.
#'                centering only:
#'                \itemize{
#'                  \item A single logical (default \code{TRUE}) applied to all \code{vars}.
#'                  \item An unnamed logical vector the same length as \code{vars},
#'                        matched by position.
#'                  \item A named logical vector, e.g. \code{c(height = TRUE, weight = FALSE)}.
#'                        Any variable in \code{vars} not named here defaults to \code{TRUE}.
#'                }
#'                Variables with \code{scale = TRUE} are run through
#'                \code{datawizard::standardise()} (centered AND scaled to SD = 1).
#'                Variables with \code{scale = FALSE} are run through
#'                \code{datawizard::center()} instead, so they are still
#'                mean-centered but left on their original scale (SD unchanged).
#'                Either way the new "Scl" column is always created.
#' @param ...     Additional arguments passed on to \code{datawizard::standardise()}
#'                and \code{datawizard::center()} (e.g. \code{robust}).
#'                Note: only arguments valid for both functions can safely be
#'                passed this way (see Details).
#'
#' @return A list of data frames (same length/order as \code{df_list}), each
#'         with new "<var>Scl" columns added.
#'
#' @examples
#' \dontrun{
#' library(datawizard)
#'
#' df1 <- data.frame(height = rnorm(10, 170, 10), weight = rnorm(10, 70, 15))
#' df2 <- data.frame(height = rnorm(10, 165, 8),  weight = rnorm(10, 65, 12))
#'
#' dfs <- list(df1, df2)
#'
#' # Standardise both variables in every data frame
#' out <- standardise_list(dfs, vars = c("height", "weight"))
#'
#' # Fully standardise height, but only center weight (weightScl keeps its
#' # original SD, just shifted to a mean of 0)
#' out2 <- standardise_list(dfs, vars = c("height", "weight"),
#'                           scale = c(height = TRUE, weight = FALSE))
#' }
#'
#' @export
standardise_list <- function(df_list, vars, scale = TRUE, ...) {

  # --- Input checks --------------------------------------------------------
  if (!is.list(df_list) || !all(vapply(df_list, is.data.frame, logical(1)))) {
    stop("`df_list` must be a list of data frames.")
  }
  if (!is.character(vars) || length(vars) == 0) {
    stop("`vars` must be a non-empty character vector of column names.")
  }
  if (!is.logical(scale)) {
    stop("`scale` must be logical (TRUE/FALSE), optionally named.")
  }

  # --- Expand `scale` into a named logical vector aligned with `vars` -----
  if (length(scale) == 1) {
    scale <- stats::setNames(rep(scale, length(vars)), vars)
  } else {
    if (is.null(names(scale))) {
      if (length(scale) != length(vars)) {
        stop("`scale` must be length 1, named, or the same length as `vars`.")
      }
      names(scale) <- vars
    }
    # Any vars not explicitly named in `scale` default to TRUE
    missing_vars <- setdiff(vars, names(scale))
    if (length(missing_vars) > 0) {
      scale <- c(scale, stats::setNames(rep(TRUE, length(missing_vars)), missing_vars))
    }
    scale <- scale[vars]  # align order, drop any extras not in `vars`
  }

  # --- Apply to each data frame --------------------------------------------
  lapply(df_list, function(df) {

    present_vars <- intersect(vars, names(df))
    absent_vars  <- setdiff(vars, names(df))

    if (length(absent_vars) > 0) {
      warning("Columns not found and skipped: ", paste(absent_vars, collapse = ", "))
    }

    for (v in present_vars) {
      new_name <- paste0(v, "Scl")

      if (isTRUE(scale[[v]])) {
        df[[new_name]] <- datawizard::standardise(df[[v]], ...)
      } else {
        df[[new_name]] <- datawizard::center(df[[v]], ...)
      }
    }

    df
  })
}

```

## filter and impute missing age data (median imputation)

```{R}

# filter data to exclude the missing age participant and the missing response data
subjDataNoAmb.cc <- subjDataNoAmb |> dplyr::filter(!is.na(Age) & !is.na(TrialNumber))

# first create a participant-level dataset
subj_dat <- subjData |> dplyr::select(ID, Age) |> dplyr::distinct()

# create a median imputation for missing age data
subj_dat.med <- subj_dat |> dplyr::mutate(Age = ifelse(is.na(Age),
                                                   median(Age, na.rm=TRUE),
                                                   Age))

# now merge the imputed age data back into the main dataset
subjData.med <- subjData |> dplyr::select(-Age) |> dplyr::left_join(subj_dat.med, by="ID")

# now filter the dataset to exclude ambient-only stimuli
subjDataNoAmb.med <- subjData.med |> dplyr::filter(UASLAeq != "Baseline") |>
  droplevels()

```

```{r}
  droplevels()

subjDataNoAmb.med <- rbind(subjDataNoAmb.med[subjDataNoAmb.med$SessionPart == "A", ] |>
                             dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE)),
                    subjDataNoAmb.med[subjDataNoAmb.med$SessionPart == "B", ] |>
                      dplyr::mutate(PartTrialNumberScl = datawizard::standardise(PartTrialNumber, scale=TRUE))) |>
  droplevels()

```

# Add external data

## Aalmoes (NLR) HA curves

```{r}

paramKNLR <- c(0.168, 0.152, 0.138, 0.158, 0.189, 0.148, 0.116, 0.085)
paramX0LAENLR <- c(82.2, 78.9, 77.4, 81.8, 81.0, 83.8, 92.2, 93.4)

rangeLAENLR <- seq(50, 90, by=0.1)

pHALAENLRFunc <- function(paramK, paramX0, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-paramK*(abscissa - paramX0)))
  return(pHA)
} 

pHALAENLR <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAENLR,
                        LAEScl = rangeLAENLR - (max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) - max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl)),
                        Quad1=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[1], paramX0LAENLR[1], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad2=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[2], paramX0LAENLR[2], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad3=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[3], paramX0LAENLR[3], rangeLAENLR),
                        Quad4=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[4], paramX0LAENLR[4], rangeLAENLR))

pHALAENLR <- pHALAENLR |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Quad1, Quad2, Quad3, Quad4), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAENLR LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRAdj <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                           LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAENLR
pHALAENLRUASRange <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

# adjust pHALAENLRUASRange LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRUASRangeAdj <- pHALAENLRUASRange |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                           LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

pHALAENLRAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAENLR,
                           LAEScl = rangeLAENLR - (max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) - max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl)),
                           Air_taxi=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[6], paramX0LAENLR[6], rangeLAENLR),
                           Helicopter_1=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[7], paramX0LAENLR[7], rangeLAENLR),
                           Helicopter_2=pHALAENLRFunc(paramKNLR[8], paramX0LAENLR[8], rangeLAENLR))

pHALAENLRAir <- pHALAENLRAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Air_taxi, Helicopter_1, Helicopter_2), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# adjust pHALAENLRAir LAE and LAEScl columns by -6 dB and make a new dataframe
pHALAENLRAirAdj <- pHALAENLRAir |> dplyr::mutate(LAE = LAE - 6,
                                                 LAEScl = LAEScl - 6)

# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAENLRSel <- pHALAENLR |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAENLRSelAir <- pHALAENLRAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)


```

## Kawai (EMPA) HA curves

```{r}

paramb0EMPA <- c(-11.06)
paramb1LAEEMPA<- c(0.17)
paramtauSrcEMPA <- c(-0.91)

rangeLAEEMPA <- seq(53, 80, by=0.1)

pHALAEEMPAFunc <- function(paramb0, paramb1, paramtau, abscissa){
  pHA <- 1/(1 + exp(-(paramb0 + paramb1*abscissa + paramtau)))
  return(pHA)
} 

pHALAEEMPA <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEEMPA,

                        M300=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauSrcEMPA[1], rangeLAEEMPA))

pHALAEEMPA <- pHALAEEMPA |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Mav2, M300), names_to="UAS", values_to="pHA")

# make a new dataframe containing the min and max values at each LAE value from pHALAEEMPA
pHALAEEMPAUASRange <- pHALAEEMPA |> dplyr::group_by(LAE, LAEScl) |>
                        dplyr::summarise(pHAmin = min(pHA),
                                         pHAmax = max(pHA), .groups='drop')

paramtauAirEMPA <- c(-1.66, -1.68, -1.76)

pHALAEEMPAAir <- data.frame(LAE = rangeLAEEMPA,
                            LAEScl = rangeLAEEMPA -
                              (max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) -
                                 max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl)),
                        Helicopter=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],

                        Propeller=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                            paramtauAirEMPA[2], rangeLAEEMPA),
                        Jet=pHALAEEMPAFunc(paramb0EMPA[1], paramb1LAEEMPA[1],
                                           paramtauAirEMPA[3], rangeLAEEMPA))

pHALAEEMPAAir <- pHALAEEMPAAir |> tidyr::pivot_longer(cols=c(Helicopter, Propeller, Jet), names_to="Type", values_to="pHA")

# filter for pHA~0.5 and pHA~0.25
pHALAEEMPASel <- pHALAEEMPA |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
pHALAEEMPASelAir <- pHALAEEMPAAir |> dplyr::filter(abs(pHA - 0.5) < 0.002 | abs(pHA - 0.25) < 0.002)
```

# Change in mean annoyance rating - Parts A & B combined analysis

## Categorical variables

### fit logistic models: ordbeta glmmTMB and GEE fractional logit

#### model 1 formula

```{r}

m1formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ 1 + SessionPart + TrialNumberScl +
                    UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                   UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation +
                   UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType +
                   AmbientEnv*UASType +
                   (1 + AmbientEnv + I(log10(UASEvents)) | ID)

# extract only fixed effects from m1formula
m1bformula <- update(m1formula, . ~ . - (1 + AmbientEnv + I(log10(UASEvents)) | ID))


# include personal factors
m1cformula <- update(m1bformula, . ~ . +
                     NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                     Age + Sex + NSSTotal + Area_soundscape2)

# exclude SessionPart
m1dformula <- update(m1bformula, . ~ . - SessionPart)

m1Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m1formula)), drop=FALSE]
m1cData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m1cformula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m1bformula, data=m1Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m1cformula, data=m1cData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m1dformula, data=m1Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)


```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

set.seed(999)
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(formula=m1formula, dispformula= ~ 1 + AmbientEnv, data=m1Data,
                       family=ordbeta(link='logit'),
                       control=glmmTMBctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(m1, ci=95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='robust', verbose=TRUE)

m1b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1bformula, data=m1Data,
                          id=ID, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m1c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1cformula, data=m1cData,
                          id=ID, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m1d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m1dformula, data=m1Data,
                          id=ID, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m1b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m1c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m1d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1b, m1c, m1d)

nd <- na.omit(m1Data)
ndc <- na.omit(m1cData)

me_predict_fn <- function(fit, newdata) {
  marginaleffects::predictions(fit, newdata=newdata, re.form=NA,
                                type="response",
                               allow.new.levels=TRUE,
                               vcov = FALSE)$estimate
}

m1_cv <- cv_glmmTMB(m1, K=cv_folds, id_col='ID', seed=cv_seed, workers=n_cores,
                   control=glmmTMBctrl,
                   backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                       direction="reverse",
                                                       squeeze="none"),
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                predict_fn=me_predict_fn,
                                agg_cols='StimID', data=nd) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

m1b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1b, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))


m1c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1c, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndc, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

m1d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m1d, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

compare_cv_results(list(m1=m1_cv, m1b=m1b_cv, m1c=m1c_cv, m1d=m1d_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m1dpredMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m1d, newdata=na.omit(m1Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents", "UASType",
                                                       "UASOperation", "AmbientEnv"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m1d, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m1dpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m1dpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m1dpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnCatModCal_geeQb"

if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

```{r}
m1dformula
modelStep$final
```

```{r}
geeCorStr(m1eformula, data=m1Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
```

```{r}
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m1epredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m1epredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m1epredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnCatModRdCal_geeQb"

if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

## UAS info only

### LAE, events and trial sequence comparison model

#### model 2 formula

```{r}

m2formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents))

m2Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m2formula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m2formula, data=m1Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m2 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m2formula, data=m2Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m2, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1d, m1e, m2)

m2_cv <- cv_glmgee(m2, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m2Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

compare_cv_results(list(m1d=m1d_cv, m1e=m1e_cv, m2=m2_cv))

```

```{r}
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnLAEModCal_geeQb"

}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 3 formula

```{r}

m3formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
  UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m3Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m3formula)), drop=FALSE]

m3aformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgBinScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
  UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m3aData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m3aformula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m3formula, data=m3Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)


geeCorStr(m3aformula, data=m3aData, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m3 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3formula, data=m3Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m3a <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m3aformula, data=m3aData,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m3, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m3a, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1d, m1e, m2, m3, m3a)

nd <- na.omit(m3Data)
nda <-  na.omit(m3aData)

m3_cv <- cv_glmgee(m3, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

m3a_cv <- cv_glmgee(m3a, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nda, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

compare_cv_results(list(m1d=m1d_cv, m1e=m1e_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3=m3_cv, m3a=m3a_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m3predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m3, newdata=na.omit(m3Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m3, type='bias-corrected'),
                                                 type='response',
                                                transform=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m3predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m3predMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m3predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnLAESQCal_geeQb"

if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m3formula, data = m3Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m3formula, data=m3Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m3Data$StimID[kept_rows]


stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m3b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 200)

coef(m3b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m3b, s = "lambda.1se")


```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m3b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m3b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m3b$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.55, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m3b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m3b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.55, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnLAESQNoEnv_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

```{r}
  filename = "dA_LAESQ_noEnv_Qb"
  saveRDS(m3, file=file.path(outDataPath, paste(filename, ".rds", sep="")))
  
}
```

```{r}
                                data=na.omit(m5Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                                      direction="reverse",
                                                                      squeeze="none"),
                                workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

compare_cv_results(list(m1d=m1d_cv, m1e=m1e_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3=m3_cv, m4=m4_cv, m5=m5_cv))
```

```{r}

m5predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m5, newdata=na.omit(m5Data),
                                                  by=c("StimID",
                                                       "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m5, type='bias-corrected'),

                                                                             direction='reverse',
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m5predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m5predMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m5predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m5formula, data = m5Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m5formula, data=m5Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m5Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m5b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance', standardize=TRUE,
                         lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m5b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m5b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m5b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m5b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m5b$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m5b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m5b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')


filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMnLAESQEnv_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

## UAS-env loudness diff

### LAEdiff with events

#### model 6 formula

```{r}

m6formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
                            I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents))

m6Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m6formula)), drop=FALSE]

m6bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
                            I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl)) +
              I(log10(UASEvents))


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m6formula, data=m6Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m6bformula, data=m6Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and check parameters

```{r}

m6 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m6formula, data=m6Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m6b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m6bformula, data=m6Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m6, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m6b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1d, m1e, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m6b)

m6_cv <- cv_glmgee(m6, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m6Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                        direction="reverse",
                                                        squeeze="none"),
                  workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

m6b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m6b, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m6Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                        direction="reverse",
                                                        squeeze="none"),
                  workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))


compare_cv_results(list(m1d=m1d_cv, m1e=m1e_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3=m3_cv, m4=m4_cv,
                        m5=m5_cv, m6=m6_cv, m6b=m6b_cv))
```

#### model 7 formula

```{r}

m7formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
              I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
              UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl +
                                    UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                                    UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m7bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
              I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
              UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO305ExMaxLRScl +
                                    UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + UASFluctECMA10ExBin +
                                    UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m7Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m7formula)), drop=FALSE]
```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

m7predMeans <- marginaleffects::avg_predictions(m7, newdata=na.omit(m7Data),

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m7predMeans,

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans

  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
```

```{r}
modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m7,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m7formula
modelStep$final

```


#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m7formula, data = m7Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m7formula, data=m7Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m7Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m7c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-40, nlambda = 500)

coef(m7c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m7c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m7c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m7c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m7c$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m7c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m7c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

  
filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMdLAESQ_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}

```

## UAS detectability

### fit and examine detectability only model

#### model 8 formula

```{r}

m8formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents))

m8bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents))

m8Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m8formula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m8formula, data=m8Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m8bformula, data=m8Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

```{r}

m8 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m8formula, data=m8Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m8b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m8bformula, data=m8Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m8, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m8b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}}

m8.resP <- residuals(m8, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,
                      pch=1, col=mycolours[3], identify=10)

gee_residplot(m8, residual_vals=m8.resP,
              colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4, text=element_text (family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Fitted values", y="Standardised Pearson residuals")

m8.resM <- residuals(m8, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m8,
                    clusterVar=m8.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m8.Cook <- cooks.distance(m8, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m8, clusterVar=m8.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m8)

```

```{r}
# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m9predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m9formula, data = m9Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m9formula, data=m9Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m9Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m9c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-200, nlambda = 600)

coef(m9c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m9c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m9c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean


# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m9c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m9c$lambda.min*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m9c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m9c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = -max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.25, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

  
filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMDetSQ_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### dSQ model

#### model 10 formula

```{r}

m10formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl)) + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m10bformula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
  I(exp(0.026*Detect0p5dBIntMaxLRScl))*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m10Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m10formula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m10formula, data=m10Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m10bformula, data=m10Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and check parameters

```{r}

m10 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10formula, data=m10Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m10b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m10bformula, data=m10Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m10, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m10b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1d, m1e, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7,
                    m8, m9, m10, m10b)

m10_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                        direction="reverse",
                                                        squeeze="none"),
                  workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

m10b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m10b, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m10Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                                        direction="reverse",
                                                        squeeze="none"),
                  workers=n_cores) |>

          cv_aggregated_metrics(backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
                                "reverse", squeeze="none"))

compare_cv_results(list(m1d=m1d_cv, m2=m2_cv, m3=m3_cv, m4=m4_cv, m5=m5_cv,
                        m6=m6_cv, m7=m7_cv, m8=m8_cv, m9=m9_cv, m10=m10_cv, m10b=m10b_cv))
```

```{r}
                                                                             squeeze='none')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - m10cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m10cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dAnnoyMean', measured_ci_low='dAnnoyMeanCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dAnnoyMeanCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m10cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMean,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dAnnoyMeanCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +
  
  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[1], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-2, 10, by=1), limits=c(-1, 9)) +
  
  labs(x="Mean change in annoyance (test)", y="Predicted mean change in annoyance") +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6.75, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.1, y=6, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$rmse, 3))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.1, y = 5.25, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.3f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse, 3))), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

## UAS all metrics


#### model 11 formula

```{r}

m11formula <- dAnnoyanceOrdBetaScl ~ TrialNumberScl +
  I(exp(0.03*LAELAF50diffScl))*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  dTonalSHMIntAvgMaxLRScl*dSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl +
  dImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dFluctECMA10ExBin +
  dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m11Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m11formula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m11formula, data=m11Data, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

```{r}

m11 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m11formula, data=m11Data,
                         family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m11, ci=0.95, exponentiate=FALSE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}}

m11.resP <- residuals(m11, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE,
                      pch=1, col=mycolours[3], identify=10)

gee_residplot(m11, residual_vals=m11.resP,
              colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.3) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4, text=element_text (family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Fitted values", y="Standardised Pearson residuals")

m11.resM <- residuals(m11, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m11,
                    clusterVar=m11.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m11.Cook <- cooks.distance(m11, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m11, clusterVar=m11.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m11)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m1d, m2, m3, m3c, m4, m5, m6, m7,
                    m8, m9, m10, m10c, m11)

m11_cv <- cv_glmgee(m11, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                  data=na.omit(m11Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                  return_predictions=TRUE,
                  backtransform_fn=\(x) betaTransform(x, -10, 10,
```

#### test model interactions

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m11,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m11formula
modelStep$final

```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m11formula, data = m11Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m11formula, data=m11Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m11Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m11b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=quasibinomial(link='logit'),
                         alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                         standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 500)

coef(m11b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m11b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m11b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m11b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m11b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m11b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m11b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

  
filename <- "PtsABdAnnoyMDetSQ_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
                             stimDataNoAmb$LAELAF50diffScl, sep=5) +
              
              scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(-10, 10, by=1), limits=c(-2, 8)) +
              
              labs(x=expression(paste(UAS~italic(d*"'")[Sigma*0.5*s],",",~dB~re.~1)), y="Mean change in annoyance")
```

```{r}

set.seed(808)

# benchmark timing
testdAm <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  
    'LMM_model' = {m0LMM <- lme4::lmer(dAnnoyance ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents))
                                              + TrialNumberScl +
                                             (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl  + I(log10(UASEvents)) | ID),
                                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, REML=FALSE,

    'GEE-LM_model' = {m0GEELM <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dAnnoyance ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents))
                                              + TrialNumberScl,
                                                data=subjDataNoAmb, family=gaussian(link='identity'),

                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "TrialNumberScl [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                       bias_correction=FALSE)},
    
    'GEE-LM_prediction' = {m0GEELMpred <- ggeffects::predict_response(m0GEELM,

                                                              "TrialNumberScl [0]"),
```

# Change in highly annoyed

## Categorical variables

### model 12 formula

```{r}

m12formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ 1 + SessionPart + TrialNumberScl +
                    UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                   UASLAEMaxLRScl*AmbientEnv*UASOperation +
                   UASLAEMaxLRScl*UASType +
                   AmbientEnv*UASType

m12Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m12formula)), drop=FALSE]

m12bformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . +
                        NationGeo2 + AAM_attitude2 + Home_Area2 +
                      Age + Sex + NSSTotal + Area_soundscape2)

m12bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m12bformula)), drop=FALSE]

m12cformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . +
                        Home_Area2 +
                      Sex)

m12dformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . - SessionPart)

m12eformula <- update(m12formula, . ~ . - UASLAEMaxLRScl*I(log10(UASEvents)))

```

### run model

#### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m12formula, data=m12Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12bformula, data=m12bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12cformula, data=m12bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12dformula, data=m12Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m12eformula, data=m12Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                 id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

```{r}


m12 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12formula, data=m12Data,
                          id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12_ind <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12formula, data=m12Data,
                          id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='independence')

m12b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12bformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='independence')

m12b_exch <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12bformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12cformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='exchangeable')

m12c_ind <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12cformula, data=m12bData,
                          id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          corstr='independence')

m12d <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12dformula, data=m12Data,
                           id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                           corstr='exchangeable')

m12e <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(formula=m12eformula, data=m12Data,
                           id=ID, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                           corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m12, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12d, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m12e, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m12b, m12c, m12d, m12e)

nd <- na.omit(m12Data)
ndb <- na.omit(m12bData)

m12_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                      data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE,
                      workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12_ind_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12_ind, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                      data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE,
                      workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12b, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12b_exch_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12b_exch, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12c_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12c, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                      data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE,
                      workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12c_ind_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12c_ind, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                      data=ndb, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE,
                      workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics()

m12d_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12d, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                      data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE,
                      workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m12e_cv <- cv_glmgee(m12e, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                      data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                      return_predictions=TRUE,
                      workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m12b=m12b_cv,
                        m12_ind=m12_ind_cv, m12b_exch=m12b_exch_cv,
                        m12c=m12c_cv, m12c_ind=m12c_ind_cv,
                        m12d=m12d_cv, m12e=m12e_cv))

```

### model diagnostics

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}}

m12.resP <- residuals(m12, type="pearson", plot.it=FALSE)

used <- complete.cases(m12Data[all.vars(m12formula)])

arm::binnedplot(fitted(m12), m12.resP)
arm::binnedplot(m12Data$UASLAEMaxLRScl[used], residuals(m12, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASLAEMaxLRScl")
arm::binnedplot(m12Data$UASEvents[used], residuals(m12, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "UASEvents")
arm::binnedplot(m12Data$TrialNumberScl[used], residuals(m12, type = "pearson"),
                 xlab = "TrialNumberScl")

m12.resM <- residuals(m12, type="mahalanobis", plot.it=FALSE)

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m12,
                    clusterVar=m12.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

m12.Cook <- cooks.distance(m12, plot.it=FALSE)

geeCluster_stemplot(m12, clusterVar=m12.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m12)
```
