### test model interactions

#### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}

modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m12,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m12formula
modelStep$final

```

### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m12predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=na.omit(m12Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents", "UASType",
                                           "UASOperation", "AmbientEnv"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m12, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m12predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m12predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m12predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoyMnCatModCal_gee"

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

### analyse population-average predictions

```{r}
m12DataFit <- insight::get_data(m12)
m12predType <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=subset(m12DataFit,
                                                             UASEvents==1),
                                                    variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                      min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      length.out=25)),
                                                  by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASType",
                                                       "AmbientEnv",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m12, type="bias-corrected"))

m12predType1 <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=subset(m12DataFit,
                                                             UASEvents==1),
                                                    variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                      min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      length.out=25)),
                                                  by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "UASType",
                                                       "UASEvents"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m12, type="bias-corrected"))

m12predOp <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=subset(m12DataFit,
                                                             UASEvents==1),
                                                      variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                          min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                          max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                          length.out=25)),
                                                      by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                           "UASOperation",
                                                           "AmbientEnv",
                                                           "UASEvents"),
                                                      vcov=vcov(m12, type="bias-corrected"))

m12predEnv <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12, newdata=subset(m12DataFit,
                                                             UASEvents==1),
                                                      variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                          min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                          max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),

                                                      by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",

                                          by = c("UASLAEMaxLRScl", "UASEvents",
                                                 "UASOperation", "AmbientEnv"),
                                          vcov = vcov(m12, type = "bias-corrected"))
```

```{r}

p1 <- ggplot(data=subset(m12predType, UASEvents==1)) +
              theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1.35,
                    text = element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
                    axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
              
              geom_point(data=subset(stimDataNoAmb, UASEvents==1), aes(x=UASLAEMaxLRScl, y=dHighAnnoyProp,
                                                 colour=UASType, shape=UASType),
                         alpha=0.35, size=2) +
              
              geom_ribbon(aes(x=UASLAEMaxLRScl, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high, fill=UASType),
                          alpha=0.15) +
              
              geom_line(aes(x=UASLAEMaxLRScl, y=estimate, colour=UASType), linewidth=1) +
              
              scale_color_viridis(option='plasma', direction=-1, discrete=TRUE, begin = 0.2, end = 0.8,
                                  guide=guide_legend(title="UAS type", reverse=FALSE)) +
              scale_fill_viridis(option='plasma', direction=-1, discrete=TRUE, begin = 0.2, end = 0.8,
                                 guide=guide_legend(title="UAS type", reverse=FALSE)) +
              scale_shape_manual(values=c(10, 11, 12), guide=guide_legend(title="UAS type", reverse=FALSE)) +
              
              rescaleTicks(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR,

              scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 1)) +
              
              labs(x=expression(paste(UAS~italic(L)[AE],",",~dB)), y="Mean change in annoyance") +
              facet_grid(rows = vars(AmbientEnv))

# send subset(m12predType1, UASEvents==1) to group_by to get min and max at each x (LAEScl) for geom_ribbon layers
m12predType1UASRange <- subset(m12predType1, UASEvents==1) |>
  group_by(UASLAEMaxLRScl) |>
  summarise(pHAmin = min(estimate),
            pHAmax = max(estimate),
            .groups = 'drop')

# incorporate m12predType1UASRange into pHALAEUASRangeAll with study 'Present study'
m12predType1UASRange <- m12predType1UASRange |>
  dplyr::mutate(LAE = UASLAEMaxLRScl  + stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR[1] - stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl[1],
                LAEScl = UASLAEMaxLRScl) |> dplyr::select(LAE, LAEScl, pHAmin, pHAmax)

pHALAEUASRangeAll <- rbind(pHALAEUASRangeAll,
                           m12predType1UASRange |> dplyr::mutate(Study = "Present study")
)

# repeat for pHALAEUASRangeAllAdj
pHALAEUASRangeAllAdj <- rbind(pHALAEUASRangeAllAdj,
                              m12predType1UASRange |> dplyr::mutate(Study = "Present study")
)
```

### personal factors model

#### population-average predictions

```{r}

m12bDataFit <- insight::get_data(m12b)
m12bpredAtt <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12b, newdata=m12bDataFit,
                                                    variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                      min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      length.out=25)),
                                                  by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "AAM_attitude2"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m12b, type="bias-corrected"))

m12bpredAoR <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12b, newdata=m12bDataFit,
                                                    variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                      min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      length.out=25)),
                                                  by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                                       "Home_Area2"),
                                                  vcov=vcov(m12b, type="bias-corrected"))

m12dpredAtt <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m12d, newdata=insight::get_data(m12d),
                                                    variables = list(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(
                                                      min(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl),
                                                      length.out=25)),
                                                  by=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl",
```

```{r}
              labs(x=expression(paste(UAS~italic(L)[AE],",",~dB)),
                   y=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb])))

filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoyCatModAoR_gee"
```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m13predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m13, newdata=na.omit(m13Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "UASLAEMaxLRScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m13, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m13predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m13predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m13predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

}
```

### full SQ model

#### model 14 formula

```{r}

m14formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonLdECMAPowAvgBinScl*UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBin + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m14Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m14formula)), drop=FALSE]

m14bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBin + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m14bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m14bformula)), drop=FALSE]
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m14bformula, data = m14bData)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m14bformula, data=m14bData)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m14bData$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))


set.seed(808)
m14d <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m14d, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m14d, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m14d$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14d$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14d$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m14d$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m14d$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoyLAESQEnv_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

```{r}
# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m15predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

### full SQ model

#### model 16 formula

```{r}

m16formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*AmbientEnv + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBin + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR

m16Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m16formula)), drop=FALSE]

m16bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*AmbientEnv +
  UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBin + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR


```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m16formula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m16bformula, data=m16Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

```{r}

m16 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16formula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m16b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m16bformula, data=m16Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m16, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m16b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14b, m15, m16, m16b)

nd <- na.omit(m16Data)

m16_cv <- cv_glmgee(m16, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m16b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m16b, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=nd, agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14b=m14b_cv,
                        m15=m15_cv, m16=m16_cv, m16b=m16b_cv))

```

```{r}
modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m16b,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m16bformula
modelStep$final
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m16bformula, data = m16Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m16bformula, data=m16Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m16Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m16c <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m16c, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m16c, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m16c$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16c$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16c$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m16c$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m16c$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoyNSQEnv_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r}
m16dpredNS <- m16dpredNS |> dplyr::mutate(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl = factor(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl),
                                          UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl))
m16dpredNT <- m16dpredNT |> dplyr::mutate(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl),
                                          UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl = factor(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl))


# Find the midpoint to split the raw data into Min/Max categories
low_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.1)
hi_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.9)
midpoint <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.5)

# Apply the factor grouping to the raw data
stimDataNoAmbTemp1 <- stimDataNoAmb |>
  mutate(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(
    ifelse(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl <= midpoint, low_val, hi_val),
    levels = c(low_val, hi_val)
  ))

# Find the midpoint to split the raw data into Min/Max categories
low_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl, 0.1)
hi_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl, 0.9)
midpoint <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl, 0.5)

stimDataNoAmbTemp2 <- stimDataNoAmb |>
  mutate(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl = factor(
    ifelse(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl <= midpoint, low_val, hi_val),
    levels = c(low_val, hi_val)
  ))
```

## UAS-env difference

### LAEdiff with events

#### model 17 formula

```{r}

m17formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + LAELAeqdiffScl*I(log10(UASEvents))

m17bformula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + LAELAF90diffScl*I(log10(UASEvents))

m17Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m17formula)), drop=FALSE]
m17bData <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m17bformula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m17formula, data=m17Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

geeCorStr(m17bformula, data=m17bData, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

```{r}

m17 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17formula, data=m17Data,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

m17b <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m17bformula, data=m17bData,
                         family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         id=ID,
                         corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m17, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
geeParams(m17b, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14b, m15, m16, m16b, m17, m17b)

m17_cv <- cv_glmgee(m17, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m17Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

m17b_cv <- cv_glmgee(m17b, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m17bData), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14b=m14b_cv,
                        m15=m15_cv, m16=m16_cv, m16b=m16b_cv,
                        m17=m17_cv, m17b=m17b_cv))

```

#### analyse and visualise calibration

```{r}

m17predMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m17, newdata=na.omit(m17Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",
                                           "LAELAeqdiffScl",
                                           "UASEvents"),
                                      vcov=vcov(m17, type='bias-corrected')) |>
  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m17predMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m17predMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m17predMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

  geom_point(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate), size=1.75, shape=4, stroke=0.75, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.5) +

  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, xmin=responseCI_Low, xmax=responseCI_High,
                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0, 1, by=0.1), labels=seq(0, 100, by=10), limits=c(0, 0.7)) +
  
  labs(x=expression(paste("%"~Highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]~"("~test~")")), y=expression(paste(Predicted~"%"~highly~annoyed~"|"~HA~"'"[amb]))) +
  
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)

filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoyMndLAEModCal_gee"

if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=4, height=4, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}}

# plot Mahalanobis residuals with ggplot2 on a stem plot replacing the index by the corresponding participant ID
geeCluster_stemplot(m17,
                    clusterVar=m17.resM,
                    colour=mycolours[2], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Mahalanobis distance")

        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m17)
```

```{r}
m17formula
```

```{r}

m18formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + LAELAeqdiffScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl*UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl + UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBin + UASRoughFZ05ExMaxLR
```

##### stepwise back removal of variables

```{r}
modelStep <- glmtoolbox::stepCriterion(model=m18,
                                       criterion='agpc', test='score',
                                       direction='backward',
                                       varest='bias-corrected')

m18formula
modelStep$final
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m18formula, data = m18Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m18formula, data=m18Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m18Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m18b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-100, nlambda = 500)

coef(m18b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m18b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m18b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m18b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m18b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')

filename <- "PtsABdHiAnnoydLAESQ_glmnetQb"
 
if (saveplots){
  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""), width=10, height=5,
         path=file.path(outFigPath, "svg"), system_fonts = list('serif'="Times New Roman"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".svg", sep=""))

  ggsave(filename=paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""), width=10, height=5, path=file.path(outFigPath, "pdf"))
  unlink(paste(filename, ".pdf", sep=""))
}


```

##### fit elastic net-informed model

###### formula

```{r}

m18cformula <- update(m18formula, . ~ . - LAELAeqdiffScl - LAELAeqdiffScl:I(log10(UASEvents)))

```

###### run model

####### check correlation structure

```{r}
           id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)
```

```{r}

m18c <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m18cformula, data=m18Data,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m18c, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)
```

```{r}

m18cpredMeans <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m18c, newdata=na.omit(m18Data),
                                      by=c("StimID",

  dplyr::arrange(StimID)

R2means <- 1 - sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - m18cpredMeans$estimate)^2)/sum((stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp - mean(stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp))^2)

eRMSE <- epsilonRMSE(measured_data=stimDataNoAmb, predicted_data=m18cpredMeans,
                     measured_target='dHighAnnoyProp', measured_ci_low='dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low',
                     measured_ci_high='dHighAnnoyPropCI_High', fitted='estimate')

# using ggplot, plot the predicted fit against the responses in predictMeans
ggplot(data=cbind(m18cpredMeans,
                  response=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyProp,
                  responseCI_Low=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_Low,
                  responseCI_High=stimDataNoAmb$dHighAnnoyPropCI_High)) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=1, text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  
  
  geom_abline(aes(intercept=0, slope=1), colour='grey', alpha=0.5) +

                            y=estimate), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +
  
  geom_errorbar(mapping=aes(x=response, y=estimate, ymin=conf.low, ymax=conf.high), width=0, colour=mycolours[3], alpha=0.1) +

  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.6, label=deparse(bquote(italic(R)^2 == .(sprintf("%.3f", (round(R2means, 3)))))), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0, parse=TRUE) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x=0.01, y=0.55, label=paste0("RMSE = ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$rmse*100, 2)), "%"), family="serif", size=4, hjust = 0) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.01, y = 0.5, label = paste0("RMSE[epsilon] == ", sprintf("%.2f", round(eRMSE$epsilon_rmse*100, 2)), "*'%'"), 
  family = "serif", size = 4, hjust = 0, parse = TRUE)
```

```{r}
                                                max(stimDataNoAmb$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR),
                                                length.out = 25),
                                                UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl=seq(-0.35, 0.7, by=0.25),
                                                UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl=c(quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl,
                                                                                         0.1),
                                                                                quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl,
                                                                                         0.9))),
                                          by = c("UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR", "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl",
                                                 "UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl"),
                                          vcov = vcov(m18c, type = "bias-corrected"))

m18cpredIS <- m18cpredIS |> dplyr::mutate(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl = factor(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl),
                                          UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl))
m18cpredIT <- m18cpredIT |> dplyr::mutate(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl),
                                          UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl = factor(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl))

# Find the midpoint to split the raw data into Min/Max categories
low_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.1)
hi_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.9)
midpoint <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.5)

# Apply the factor grouping to the raw data
stimDataNoAmbTemp1 <- stimDataNoAmb |>
  mutate(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(
    ifelse(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl <= midpoint, low_val, hi_val),
    levels = c(low_val, hi_val)
  ))

# Find the midpoint to split the raw data into Min/Max categories
low_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl, 0.1)
hi_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl, 0.9)
midpoint <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl, 0.5)

stimDataNoAmbTemp2 <- stimDataNoAmb |>
  mutate(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl = factor(
    ifelse(UASSharpAurISO3PowAvgMaxLRScl <= midpoint, low_val, hi_val),
    levels = c(low_val, hi_val)
  ))
```

## UAS all metrics

#### model 19 formula

```{r}

m19formula <- dHighAnnoy ~ TrialNumberScl + UASLoudECMAPowAvgBinScl*I(log10(UASEvents)) +
  UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR + dSharpAurSHMPowAvgMaxLRScl*UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl +
  UASFluctECMA10ExBin + dRoughFZ05ExMaxLR +
  AmbLAeqMaxLRScl

m19Data <- subjDataNoAmb.med[, c(ID='ID', StimID='StimID', all.vars(m19formula)), drop=FALSE]

```

#### run model

##### check correlation structure

```{r}

geeCorStr(m19formula, data=m19Data, family=binomial(link='logit'),
          id=ID, maxit=2e3, verbose=FALSE)

```

##### fit and estimate parameters

```{r}

m19 <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(m19formula, data=m19Data,
                          family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          id=ID,
                          corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(m19, ci=0.95, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)


```

#### analyse performance

```{r}

geeModelPerformance(m12, m13, m14b, m15, m16, m16b, m17, m18, m19)

m19_cv <- cv_glmgee(m19, id_col="ID", K=cv_folds, seed=cv_seed,
                                data=na.omit(m19Data), agg_cols="StimID",
                                return_predictions=TRUE,
                                workers=n_cores) |>
          cv_aggregated_metrics() |>
  cv_binary_metrics()

compare_cv_results(list(m12=m12_cv, m13=m13_cv, m14b=m14b_cv,
                        m15=m15_cv, m16=m16_cv, m16b=m16b_cv,
                        m17=m17_cv, m18=m18_cv, m19=m19_cv))

```

```{r}
m19preddST <- avg_predictions_hybrid(m19, newdata=m19DataFit,

                                                                                         0.9))),
                                          by = c("UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR", "UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl",

m19preddSI <- m19preddSI |> dplyr::mutate(UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR = factor(UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR),
                                          UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl))

                                          UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR = factor(UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR))

# Find the midpoint to split the raw data into Min/Max categories
low_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.3)
hi_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.9)
midpoint <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl, 0.5)

# Apply the factor grouping to the raw data
stimDataNoAmbTemp1 <- stimDataNoAmb |>
  mutate(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl = factor(
    ifelse(UASTonalAwSHMInt05ExMaxLRScl <= midpoint, low_val, hi_val),
    levels = c(low_val, hi_val)
  ))

# Find the midpoint to split the raw data into Min/Max categories
low_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR, 0.3)
hi_val <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR, 0.9)
midpoint <- quantile(stimDataNoAmb$UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR, 0.5)

stimDataNoAmbTemp2 <- stimDataNoAmb |>
  mutate(UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR = factor(
    ifelse(UASImpulsLoudWZAvgMaxLR <= midpoint, low_val, hi_val),
    levels = c(low_val, hi_val)
  ))
```

```{r}
m19formula
```

#### regularised version of model with glmnet

```{r}

mf <- model.frame(m19formula, data = m19Data)      # na.omit happens here
kept_rows <- as.integer(rownames(mf))               # original row indices actually retained

y_matrix <- model.response(mf)
X_matrix <- model.matrix(m19formula, data=m19Data)[,-1]

StimID_kept <- m19Data$StimID[kept_rows]

stim_folds <- setNames(
  sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(unique(StimID_kept)))),
  unique(StimID_kept)
)
foldid <- stim_folds[as.character(StimID_kept)]

stopifnot(length(foldid) == nrow(X_matrix), length(y_matrix) == nrow(X_matrix))

set.seed(808)
m19b <- glmnet::cv.glmnet(x=X_matrix, y=y_matrix, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                          alpha=0.5, foldid=foldid, type.measure='deviance',
                          standardize=TRUE, lambda.min.ratio = 1e-20, nlambda = 500)

coef(m19b, s = "lambda.min")
coef(m19b, s = "lambda.1se")

```

```{r, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}

# 1. Turn the glmnet path data into a clean data frame
coefficient_paths <- broom::tidy(m19b$glmnet.fit, return_zeros=TRUE) |>
  dplyr::filter(term != "(Intercept)") # Exclude intercept to keep scale clean

# 3. Create the ggplot
ggplot(coefficient_paths, aes(x = lambda, y = estimate, color = term)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.4, alpha=0.6) +
  # Use your custom colour palette mycolours as colour scale
  # scale_color_manual(values = mycolours) +
  scale_x_log10() + # Lambda spans orders of magnitude, log-scale is best
  # scale_y_log10() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19b$lambda.min, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19b$lambda.min*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("Minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = m19b$lambda.1se, linetype = 'dotted', color = "grey", linewidth = 0.8) +
  ggplot2::annotate("text", x = m19b$lambda.1se*1.25, y = max(coefficient_paths$estimate) * 0.5, 
           label = expression(paste("1SE from minimum CV-error ",~lambda)), color = "grey", angle = 90, vjust = 0.5) +
  labs(x = expression(log[10]*(lambda)),
      y = "Coefficient estimate",
      color = "Predictors"
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = alpha("grey90", alpha=0.5), linetype='dashed'),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        aspect.ratio=1,
        text = element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14),
        legend.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=12),
        legend.position='right')
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}}
geeCluster_stemplot(m19, clusterVar=m19.Cook,
                    colour=mycolours[4], alpha=0.7) +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(), aspect.ratio=0.4,
        text=element_text(family = "serif", size=16),
        axis.text=element_text(family = "serif", size=14)) +
  labs(x="Participant ID", y="Cook's distance")

glmgee_vif(m19)
```

## Comparison between GEE-PA and GLMM-SS models with LAE predictor

### Timing comparison

```{r}

set.seed(808)

newData <- data.frame(UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(-12, 13, by=1), UASEvents=1,
                      TrialNumberScl=mean(subjDataNoAmb$TrialNumberScl))

# benchmark timing
testdHA <- microbenchmark::microbenchmark(
  
    'GLMM_model' = {model0GLMM <- lme4::glmer(dHighAnnoy ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents))
                                              + TrialNumberScl +
                                                (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) | ID),
                                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                              control=glmerctrl)},
    
    'GEE_model' = {model0GEE <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dHighAnnoy ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents))
                                              + TrialNumberScl,
                                                data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                                id=ID, corstr='exchangeable')},
    
    'GLMM_metrics' = {
                        PCP <- glmmPCP(model0GLMM)
                        cbind(performance::model_performance(model0GLMM,
                                                             metrics=c("AIC",
                                                                       "AICc",
                                                                       "BIC",
                                                                       "R2",
                                                                       "LOGLOSS")),
                                    PCP)
                        },
    
    'GEE_metrics' = {geeModelPerformance(model0GEE, verbose=TRUE)},
    
    'GLMM_prediction' = {model0GLMMpredict <- ggeffects::predict_response(model0GLMM,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "TrialNumberScl [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                       bias_correction=TRUE)},
    
    'GEE_prediction' = {model0GEEpredict <- ggeffects::predict_response(model0GEE,
                                                      terms=c("UASLAEMaxLRScl [all]",
                                                              "UASEvents [1]",
                                                              "TrialNumberScl [0]"),
                                                       type='fixed', margin='marginalmeans',
                                                      vcov=vcov(model0GEE, type="bias-corrected"))},
    times=10, unit='s', control=list(order='inorder'))

testdHA

glmmVsGEEdHA <- data.frame(model=summary(testdHA)[1,]$median/summary(testdHA)[2,]$median,
                          metrics=summary(testdHA)[3,]$median/summary(testdHA)[4,]$median,
                          pred=summary(testdHA)[5,]$median/summary(testdHA)[6,]$median,
                          total=sum(summary(testdHA)[1,]$median, summary(testdHA)[3,]$median, summary(testdHA)[5,]$median)/
                                sum(summary(testdHA)[2,]$median, summary(testdHA)[4,]$median, summary(testdHA)[6,]$median))

print(paste("Model:", glmmVsGEEdHA$model))
print(paste("Metrics:", glmmVsGEEdHA$metrics))
print(paste("Prediction:", glmmVsGEEdHA$pred))
print(paste("Total:", glmmVsGEEdHA$total))

microbenchmark:::autoplot.microbenchmark(testdHA)
microbenchmark:::boxplot.microbenchmark(testdHA)


```

### Plot comparison

```{r}

set.seed(808)

UASLAEMaxLRDummy <- seq(-12, 33, by=1) + (max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLR) -
                                            max(stimDataNoAmb$UASLAEMaxLRScl))

newData <- data.frame(UASLAEMaxLR=UASLAEMaxLRDummy,
                      UASLAEMaxLRScl=seq(-12, 33, by=1), UASEvents=1,
                      TrialNumberScl=0)

modelGLMM <- lme4::glmer(dHighAnnoy ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                             TrialNumberScl +
                           (1 + UASLAEMaxLRScl | ID),
                            data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                         control=glmerctrl)

parameters::model_parameters(modelGLMM, exponentiate=TRUE)

PCP <- glmmPCP(modelGLMM)
print(cbind(performance::model_performance(modelGLMM,
                                           metrics=c("AIC", "AICc", "BIC",
                                                               "R2", "LOGLOSS")),
            PCP))


modelGEE <- glmtoolbox::glmgee(dHighAnnoy ~ UASLAEMaxLRScl + I(log10(UASEvents)) +
                                              + TrialNumberScl,
                                  data=subjDataNoAmb, family=binomial(link='logit'),
                                  id=ID, corstr='exchangeable')

geeParams(modelGEE, ci=0.843, exponentiate=TRUE, varest='bias-corrected', verbose=FALSE)

geeModelPerformance(modelGEE)


mABdHLAElgQSq.LAElgQpredict <- modelbased::estimate_expectation(modelGLMM,

                                                                ci_method='wald')
```
